title: 红中传：2
content_zh:
“嘶这究竟是怎么回事？！”感受着身上的疼痛，那几乎快要昏厥过去的激烈疼痛，让李火旺死死咬着牙，颤抖的倒吸一口凉气。
之前的一切都在按照自己规划，从清风观出来，吃下丹阳子，为了解决丹阳子，去掉入更大的坑。
一个坑接着一个坑，一个骗局套着一个骗局，最终把那个假的李火旺彻底同化成红中，可现在的情况出现了偏差！
李火旺看着眼前的红色竹简，大千录，以及在上面蠕动的模糊血肉，以及自己面目全非的自己。
这本书是李火旺从袄景教里面拿到的，，大千录作为袄景四大法门之一，袄景教有大千录，这很正常。
可自己之前设的局明明没有这一环才对，整个袄景教高层都是自己骗来的坐忘道假扮的。
忽然李火旺想到了什么，疼到几乎把嘴唇咬穿的他抬起头来，看向眼前盘坐在扭曲黑十字上的可怖焦人。
当看到那张恐怖狰狞的面孔伴随着的五官的扭曲，开始缓缓掉下碎屑的时候，李火旺好像明白过来什么。
“呵呵呵怎么，巴虺？牯神？这场局你们也想掺和进来不成？真是他妈越来越有意思了。”
看来那个斗姥牵过来的假李火旺似乎知道了自己的存在，他在借住其他力量来反抗自己，果然不亏是另外一个李火旺，就是聪明，即便是假的。
当知道发生什么事情后，李火旺并没有阻止大千录的使用，非但如此，他经常封闭自己的神识，让巴虺影响的更深一些。
当登基正式开始，李火旺能感受自己的神识开始飘了起来，并且距离巴虺越近，当登阶最终成功的那一刻，李火旺缓缓的睁开了眼，他仰头看近在咫尺的巴虺，那蛇鳞之下的扭曲巨眼。
只能说不亏是掌控着天道的司命，对方的强大几乎让他难以直视，可是他红中可不怕这个。
“巴虺！别装了！我知道你想干什么！咱们做个交易吧！只要你能让我成为唯一的李火旺，我愿意当你的心蟠！！”
李火旺不知道巴虺有没有同意，但是他可以肯定对方听到了，既然对方能利用巴虺来对付自己，那自己同样也能用巴虺来对付他。
content_en:
"Hey, what is going on?!" Feeling the pain in his body, the intense pain that almost made him faint, Li Huowang gritted his teeth and took a trembling breath.
Everything before was according to my own plan, from Qingfengguan to eating Danyangzi, and in order to solve Danyangzi, I fell into a bigger pit.
One pit after another, one scam after another, and finally the fake Li Huowang was completely assimilated into Hong Zhong, but now the situation has gone awry!
Li Huowang looked at the red bamboo slips in front of him, the Daqianlu, the blurry flesh and blood crawling on them, and his unrecognizable self.
Li Huowang got this book from Ao Jingjiao. Da Qian Lu is one of the four major teachings of Ao Jing. It is normal for Ao Jing Jiao to have Da Qian Lu.
But the game he set up before obviously didn't have this link. The entire high-level officials of the Ao Nestorian Church were tricked by him and pretended to be Zuo Wangdao.
Suddenly, Li Huowang thought of something. The pain was so painful that he almost bit his lip. He raised his head and looked at the terrifying figure sitting on the twisted black cross in front of him.
Li Huowang seemed to understand something when he saw that terrifying and ferocious face, accompanied by the distortion of the facial features, and slowly falling debris.
"Hehehe what, Ba Hui? God Gu? Do you want to get involved in this situation? It's getting more and more interesting."
It seems that the fake Li Huowang brought over by Doulao seems to know his existence, and he is using other powers to resist him. It turns out that he is indeed another Li Huowang, he is smart, even if he is fake.
After knowing what happened, Li Huowang did not stop the use of Daqianlu. Not only that, he often closed his consciousness to let Ba Hui's influence be deeper.
When the ascension to the throne officially began, Li Huowang could feel his consciousness beginning to float up, and he was getting closer and closer to Ba Hui. When he finally succeeded in ascending the steps, Li Huowang slowly opened his eyes. He looked up and looked at Ba Hui who was very close at hand, the twisted giant eyes under the snake scales.
It can only be said that it is Si Ming who controls the way of heaven. The opponent is so powerful that it is almost difficult for him to look directly at him, but he is not afraid of this in Hongzhong.
"Ba Hui! Stop pretending! I know what you want to do! Let's make a deal! As long as you can make me the only Li Huowang, I am willing to be your favorite!!"
Li Huowang didn't know if Ba Hui agreed, but he was sure that the other party heard it. Since the other party could use Ba Hui to deal with him, he could also use Ba Hui to deal with him.
